# Growthbook <> Pronto - Demo
Date: 2026-10-16 | Duration: 49.40999984741211m

## Summary
Growth Book presented a flexible, open-source, warehouse-native experimentation and feature flagging platform that uses customer data warehouses such as Databricks, preserving data ownership and avoiding rebuilt pipelines. It supports isolated holdouts, namespaces, granular targeting, more than 30 SDKs, feature flagging, product analytics, and 50–100 experiments monthly. Embedded AI can generate dashboards, visualizations, experiment summaries, and data insights for technical and business users. Setup typically takes one to two days, with onboarding achievable within a week; Growth Book requires read-only Databricks access, queries raw data directly, and leaves data in the customer warehouse, although customer compute costs apply. Experiments support flexible targeting, gradual rollouts, sticky user assignments, Bayesian and Frequentist analysis, primary, secondary, and guardrail metrics, and transparent queries. Pronto plans an approximately three-week trial covering setup, experiment launch, and analysis, supported through Slack. Security and legal clearance, a POC agreement, success criteria, and parallel commercial discussions remain next steps.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, experimentation, feature flagging, Databricks, AI integration, trial onboarding
